1.w: Masters, provide to [your] slaves that which [is] right and that which [is] equal, knowing that you⁺ also have a Master in heaven.

2.w: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it in thanksgiving,

3.w: praying at the same time also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, on account of which also I have been bound,

4.w: so that I may make it clear, as it is necessary for me to speak.

5.w: Walk in wisdom toward those outside, redeeming the time.

6.w: Let your⁺ word [be] always in grace, having been seasoned with salt, to know how it is necessary for you⁺ to answer each one.

7.w: All the things concerning me, Tychicus will make known to you⁺—the beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow servant in the Lord,

8.w: whom I sent to you⁺ for this, that you⁺ may know the things concerning us, and he may encourage your⁺ hearts,

9.w: with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is of you⁺. They will make known to you⁺ all things here.

10.w: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you⁺, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom you⁺ received commands—if he shall come to you⁺, welcome him—

11.w: and also Jesus who [is] called Justus, these being the only fellow workers for the kingdom of God of the circumcision, who became a comfort to me.

12.w: Epaphras greets you⁺, who [is] of you⁺, a servant of Christ Jesus, always striving for you⁺ in the prayers, so that you⁺ may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.

13.w: For I testify for him that he has much distress for you⁺ and those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

14.w: Luke, the beloved physician, greets you⁺, and Demas.

15.w: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her house.

16.w: And when the letter may be read among you⁺, cause that it may be read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you⁺ also may read the one from Laodicea.

17.w: And say to Archippus: “See [to] the ministry that you received in the Lord, that you may fulfill it.”

18.w: The greeting [is] in my hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace [be] with you⁺.
